scenarios.name: tracking_normally
scenarios.description: Reference vector: command 50%, feedback 48% — a 2% tracking error, inside the allowance

scenarios.name: briefly_stuck_then_recovers
scenarios.description: Reference vector: command 80% against feedback 20% for 10 min, then the actuator catches up — the 60% error never reaches stuck_duration

scenarios.name: stuck_sustained
scenarios.description: Reference vector: command 80% against feedback 20% held past 45 min — the alarm lands at stuck_duration + alarm_delay = 2100 s, well before the reference's 2700 s observation point

scenarios.name: error_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: command 50%, feedback 40% — a delta of exactly position_error_threshold (10%); the strict `>` keeps it healthy

scenarios.name: error_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: command 50%, feedback 39.5% — a 10.5% delta clears the threshold and alarms at 2100 s

scenarios.name: reverse_error_is_symmetric
scenarios.description: Feedback above command (20% commanded, 80% reported) — `absErr` makes the test direction-blind, so an over-travelled or reverse-wired actuator alarms on the same 2100 s schedule

scenarios.name: normal_stroke_lag
scenarios.description: Transient: the command steps 20% → 80% at t=600 and the actuator takes 300 s to arrive — a 60% error for the length of the stroke, far short of stuck_duration

scenarios.name: error_clears_during_debounce
scenarios.description: Transient: the error survives stuck_duration (timer satisfied at 1800 s) but the actuator frees itself at 1920 s, inside the 300 s debounce — no alarm ever asserts

scenarios.name: error_returns_restarts_stuck_timer
scenarios.description: Transient: the actuator tracks briefly at t=600 and jams again at t=900 — the stuck timer restarts from the second jam, pushing the alarm to 900 + 2100 = 3000 s
